_comment: Provenance pin for the only files in this folder copied from the authors' release:
the MARM2.0 PySB model definition and its calibrated parameter table. Both are byte-
identical to upstream; run_frohlich2023.py refuses to run if either sha256 differs.
Everything else in the folder is written or generated here.
publication: Fröhlich F, Gerosa L, Muhlich JL, Sorger PK (2023). Mechanistic model of MAPK signaling reveals how allostery and rewiring contribute to drug resistance. Mol Syst Biol 19:e10988. doi:10.15252/msb.202210988
pinned_ref: tag/branch `resubmission` (and `main`) both point at the pinned commit

publisher_copy.item: Code EV1 of the article, MSB-19-e10988-s004.zip
publisher_copy.note: A GitHub archive of the pinned commit (its zip comment is the commit hash); the two vendored files are byte-identical in it and at the commit.

license.changes: None. Files are renamed with a frohlich2023_marm2_ prefix to sit in the flat reference/ directory; their bytes are unmodified.

reference/frohlich2023_marm2_RTKERK__pRA.role: The flattened PySB export of MARM2.0, variant pRAF (with RAF phosphorylation), the variant shown in the manuscript. It defines rules, energy patterns, initials and observables at placeholder parameter values.

reference/frohlich2023_marm2_RTKERK_pRAF.role: The 50 best calibrated parameter sets, sorted by objective value (fval). Row 0 is the best-ranked set used here. Values are linear; drug-specific names carry the drug (bind_Vemurafenib_RAF_kf for the model's bind_RAFi_RAF_kf).

MARM/data/processed_EGF_EGFR_MEKi_PRAFi_.used_for: The Fig. 2A condition, rows 0-9. Its measurement columns are already committed as reference/frohlich2023_fig2a_vemurafenib1um_egf100ngml_measurements.csv. Its protocol columns fix the simulation run_frohlich2023.py reproduces and are recorded here instead of vendoring 166 kB.
MARM/data/processed_EGF_EGFR_MEKi_PRAFi_.meaning: AMICI semantics (MARM/estimation.py get_edata -> amici.getEdataFromDataFrame): the *_preeq columns define a pre-equilibration to steady state at 1 uM vemurafenib with no EGF; t_presim = 0 means no finite-time pre-simulation; the main simulation then runs at EGF_0 = 100 ng/mL with the free EGF state re-initialized (reinitialization_state_idxs_sim). The paper: 'model simulations were pre-equilibrated to these conditions' (the 24 h drug adaptation approximated as a pseudo steady state).
MARM/data/processed_EGF_EGFR_MEKi_PRAFi_.contrast: The same table encodes a finite drug pre-treatment differently: its 22 pre-treatment time-course rows (291-312, t_presim 0.5-24 h) set Vemurafenib_0_preeq = 0 and Vemurafenib_0_presim = 1, i.e. the drug-free steady state followed by t_presim hours with drug; that includes a 24 h arm (rows 300, 310-312). t_presim is 0 in the other 562 rows, rows 0-9 among them. No row starts from the model's raw initial values.

MARM/model.py, MARM/estimation.py, MARM/.used_for: Read, not run (they import amici and pypesto). run_frohlich2023.py re-implements the two steps it needs: get_model_instance (drop the PRAFi and MEKi initials for the EGF_RAFi instance) and the solver settings of get_solver (rtol 1e-9, atol 1e-11).
